subject.title: fix(ui): reject nondecimal strings in config form number coercion

question: Should the Control UI intentionally reject JavaScript-only numeric spellings such as radix literals and leading-plus values rather than silently coercing them during config save?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent, but the accepted input grammar is a user-visible compatibility contract that cannot be selected solely from tests.

options.title: Accept the canonical numeric grammar
options.body: Keep decimal and scientific notation coercion while preserving noncanonical text for gateway schema validation; refresh against current `main` before merge.

options.title: Narrow the compatibility change
options.body: Retain additional legacy spellings where maintainers consider them supported user input, with focused coverage documenting that contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the canonical numeric grammar
recommendation.body: Keep decimal and scientific notation coercion while preserving noncanonical text for gateway schema validation; refresh against current `main` before merge.
